name: Korean peninsula
value: Missile salvo 4 Nov; 4th launch in a month
summary: North Korea fires several missiles on 4 Nov after rejecting US Binance theft claims
state: North Korea fired several missiles from the Sondok area toward the Sea of Japan on 4 Nov, its fourth weapons launch in a month, South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff said (Korea Herald; SecurityWeek/AP). It came hours after Pyongyang denied US claims it stole about $6.3bn from Binance and said it saw no need to resume diplomacy. No nuclear test or ICBM overflight has been reported.
for_you: No change to official travel advice was reported. Check FCDO guidance for South Korea and Japan if travelling.
